## Data, software & research infrastructure

Insa Bechert and **Scott Milligan** (2024).  
*COORDINATE Data Harmonisation Workshop 2* (Version 1.0.0). Simulated research data and R code. GESIS.  
[DOI](https://doi.org/10.7802/2717)

Insa Bechert, Haridhan Goswami, and **Scott Milligan** (2024).  
*Delivering Training Workshops on Child Wellbeing Data Harmonisation.* COORDINATE Deliverable D4.6, Work Package 4. Horizon 2020, Grant Agreement 101008589.

**[COORDINATE Child Wellbeing Variable Database and Harmonisation Toolbox](https://www.coordinate-network.eu/database)** (2022–2024).  
Design and technical development of a publicly accessible variable and metadata database and documented R workflows for harmonising comparative survey data on child and youth wellbeing.
